scope: The restored Mohatta Palace in Clifton, Karachi, with its Gizri and Jodhpur stone exterior, four mapped corner chhatris, clustered rooftop domes and tiled main entry.

originalReview.notes: The full palace elevation shows the pale Gizri stone body, pink stone trim, open corner chhatris, small recessed windows and clustered roof domes.

The entrance detail shows the tilework inside the recessed doorway, timber shutters, dark open center and broad pale steps. It supplements the earlier full photograph in the same restored museum period.

quallaSearch.notes: Both exact local Qualla photos have public-domain grants by their creators. The English Wikipedia original upload log binds Swerveut to the wide view and exact original size. Shahid1024’s own photo documents the entrance. The full view’s EXIF date represents the model, with the 2008 entrance used for restored-period details.
